description: Source code for a Git repository walker implementation, including functions for processing commits, trees, tags, and objects, as well as fetching objects and managing traversal state.

methods.name: walker_say
methods.description: Prints a message to stderr if verbose mode is enabled in the walker.

methods.name: report_missing
methods.description: Reports an error when a required object cannot be obtained, including current commit context.

methods.name: process_tree
methods.description: Processes a tree object, recursively processing its entries unless they are submodules.

methods.name: process_commit
methods.description: Processes a commit object, including its parents and associated tree.

methods.name: process_tag
methods.description: Processes a tag object and its tagged object.

methods.name: process_object
methods.description: Dispatches processing based on object type (commit, tree, blob, tag).

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main processing function that manages object flags, fetching, and queuing for processing.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Main processing loop that fetches and processes objects from the queue.

methods.name: interpret_target
methods.description: Interprets a target string as an OID or ref, resolving it accordingly.

methods.name: mark_complete
methods.description: Marks a reference as complete and adds it to the priority queue.

methods.name: walker_targets_stdin
methods.description: Reads target references from stdin, parsing into target and write_ref arrays.

methods.name: walker_targets_free
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for target and write_ref arrays.

methods.name: walker_fetch
methods.description: Fetches specified targets and updates references, managing transactions and progress.

methods.name: walker_free
methods.description: Cleans up and frees a walker object.
